review_fix: No Studio numbers newer than the Nov 21 snapshot, so the fix comes from the standing review: the channel's best-viewed Short (009, 1.4K) used the 'X isn't really a Y' reversal, and rule 10 says 2 of every 3 videos are brand reversals. 021 copies that pattern for the biggest store in the US the day before Black Friday: AMAZON ISN'T / A STORE on a black band over the exact Amazon boxes and logo on frame 1, line 1 is the 5-word claim, about 33 s (rule 9), and the profit split is two concrete cents-per-dollar numbers (8 cents vs 39 cents) instead of a ratio (rule 8). Paradox format (018 Paradox, 019 Story, 020 Trick), proof card back in (020 had none).
title: How Does Amazon Actually Make Money?
description:
Amazon's online store brings in most of its sales, but Amazon Web Services, the cloud business renting out computer servers, made 63% of its operating profit last quarter.
#amazon #aws #business #shorts

Sources: Amazon Q3 2026 results (Oct 29, 2026) via aboutamazon.com and Business Wire; Cord Cutters News (Oct 2026); Amazon Q4 2025 results (Feb 5, 2026)
Photos: jencu, bugeaters, stockcatalog, MDGovpics, Phillip Pessar, Rob Ireton (CC BY 2.0, Flickr)
first_comment: Be honest: did you know Amazon makes most of its profit from AWS, or did you think it was the shopping? 📦

scenes.source: Amazon Q3 2026 results (Oct 29 2026, aboutamazon.com + Business Wire via Finviz): AWS operating income $17.8B of $28.1B total operating income (63%); same pattern in FY2025 ($45.6B of $80.0B, 57%). Rhetorical reversal, explained in the video.

scenes.say: Last quarter: {$202 billion|two hundred two billion dollars} in sales.
scenes.source: Amazon Q3 2026 release: 'Net sales increased 12% to $201.9 billion in the third quarter' (aboutamazon.com; Business Wire via Finviz; Cord Cutters News 'Amazon Posts $201.9 Billion in Q3 Sales')

scenes.say: But most of the profit isn't from your shopping cart.
scenes.source: Q3 2026: AWS $17.8B of $28.1B operating income = 63%, i.e. most (aboutamazon.com + Business Wire)

scenes.say: {63%|Sixty three percent} of it came from one place.
scenes.source: 17.8 / 28.1 = 63.3% (AWS segment operating income vs total operating income, Q3 2026 release)
AWS = Amazon Web Services, an Amazon segment (Q3 2026 release)

scenes.say: It rents out computer servers to other companies.
scenes.source: AWS sells cloud computing (compute, storage) to businesses; segment description in Amazon releases and 10-K

scenes.say: On every dollar of sales, the store side in North America keeps about {8¢|eight cents}. AWS keeps {39¢|thirty nine}.
scenes.source: Q3 2026 release: North America segment sales $112.9B, operating income $8.7B (8.7/112.9 = 7.7 cents per $1); AWS sales $46.0B, operating income $17.8B (17.8/46.0 = 38.7 cents per $1). aboutamazon.com + Business Wire via Finviz

scenes.say: Amazon's own report says AWS made seventeen point eight billion in three months.

visual.quote: AWS segment operating income was $17.8 billion, compared with $11.4 billion in third quarter 2025.

scenes.source: Amazon Q3 2026 release, verbatim: 'AWS segment operating income was $17.8 billion, compared with $11.4 billion in third quarter 2025.' (aboutamazon.com and Business Wire text via Finviz)

scenes.say: The packages are the part you see. The servers are where the profit is.
scenes.source: Point of view summarising the segment numbers above
